links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT pDDI results across repeated queries
links.effect: Repeating each query yielded inconsistent results in 90% of cases.
links.quote: To assess the consistency of the results provided by Chat GPT, we repeated each query and found inconsistent results in 90% of the cases.

links.outcome: ChatGPT detection of clinically relevant drug-drug interactions versus CDSSs
links.effect: ChatGPT identified 80 pDDIs versus 280 with CDSSs; QTc-prolongation pDDIs almost entirely missed (85 vs. 8); obvious errors and inconsistent results.
links.quote: Chat GPT almost entirely neglected pDDIs with the risk to QTc prolongation (85 vs. 8), which could also not be sufficiently improved by using a specific prompt.

screen.reason: Retrospectively evaluates ChatGPT against established clinical decision support systems for identifying drug-drug interactions in 30 polypharmacy patients.
